description: Author all NEW config modules (filmTimeline, filmCopy, footage, narration, filmGrade, filmMusic) following the existing load-time-validation + config-driven pattern, with their vitest specs. This is the pure, unit-testable backbone of the film (CINEMATIC-FILM.md §3.3, §4, §6, §7, §9, §11, §12). Consumes the MEASURED VO durations and probed footage durations from FEAT-002. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: src/config/filmTimeline.ts: export FILM_FPS=30, FILM_DURATION=2700, and FILM_SCENES with the exact nine ranges from §4 (film01 0-390, film02 390-780, film02b 780-1140, film03 1140-1620, film05 1620-1860, film06 1860-2100, film07 2100-2256, film08 2256-2412, film09 2412-2700). Add validateFilmTimeline() mirroring validateTimeline() in src/config/timeline.ts: assert ranges are contiguous, start at 0, each positive, and sum to 2700 — throw the exact mismatch otherwise. Call it at module load. Also export the §5 lockup sub-beats for film09 (9.1 2412-2484, 9.2 2484-2568, 9.3 2568-2634, 9.4 2634-2700 with their 12/12 and 9/9 fades) and a validateFootageWindows()-style assertion that every storyboard shot's window + inPoint <= that clip's durationInFrames (using footage.ts durations).

src/config/footage.ts: export a FOOTAGE map key->{file, focusX, focusY, gradeKey:'cool'|'warm', durationInFrames, (optional) inPoint}, using the probed durations from FEAT-002 and sensible focal points per clip (mirror assets.ts getAsset discipline). Add getFootage(key) throwing on unknown key, out-of-range focal point, or missing durationInFrames. Every footageKey referenced by a scene must exist here.

src/config/filmCopy.ts: RE-EXPORT (do NOT re-literal) the verbatim COPY members from config/copy.ts needed on-screen: s06Tagline, s05a, s05b, s03Wordmark, s06Meta[1]. Compute capability sub-labels from the imported arrays: softwareLine = COPY.s04.software.items.join(' · '), infrastructureLine = COPY.s04.infrastructure.items.join(' · '), controlLine = COPY.s04.control.items.join(' · ') (this MUST include SCADA). Add exactly ONE brand-new literal: visionLine = 'Your business has a vision.
We build what brings it to life.' (newline between the two sentences per §9 C9). Export the Act-1 narration-class caption strings (C1 'A business doesn't fail
in one big moment.', C2 'Systems that don't talk.
Hours that don't add up.', C3 'There has to be
a better way.', C4 'Then they found a partner.') and the capability titles 'SOFTWARE'/'INFRASTRUCTURE'/'CONTROL + SECURITY'. Do NOT edit copy.ts.

src/config/narration.ts: export NARRATION as an ordered array of { id, text, startFrame, durationInFrames, file } for vo01..vo16 using the §6 table text and start frames, and the MEASURED durationInFrames from FEAT-002 (not the ~estimates). file = 'audio/vo/<id>.mp3'. vo13/vo15/vo16 text MUST === the COPY members (import and reference them so a typo is a type error); vo14 text === FILM_COPY.visionLine (as a single-line spoken string is fine, but keep the on-screen C9 newline in filmCopy). Validate at load: ids unique, startFrame in [0,FILM_DURATION), startFrame+durationInFrames <= FILM_DURATION. CRITICAL build-order step: AFTER measured durations are in, re-check the §5 lockup invariant beatEnd-(voStart+voDuration) >= 6 for vo13..vo16 against the film09 sub-beats; if any measured VO overruns its beat, start that VO earlier within its beat (beats have headroom) — never shorten a signature line's on-screen hold and keep film09 total at 288f.

src/config/filmGrade.ts: export gradeCool and gradeWarm presets COMPOSED from brand.ts GRADE tokens (gradeCool = GRADE.filter as-is + faint steel veil from GRADE.duotoneSteel; gradeWarm = slightly higher brightness/saturation within the same token family + GRADE.duotoneAmber at a higher-but-restrained opacity). Export a helper to interpolate cool->warm over the §2 window 1140->1500. Do NOT edit brand.ts.

src/config/filmMusic.ts: export track metadata (file paths track-a-tension.mp3 / track-b-hope.mp3), SHIFT_FRAME=1140, the fade windows, Track A curve clipN(f,[0,60,1020,1080,1140,1200],[0,0.9,0.9,0.3,0.3,0]) and Track B curve clipN(f,[1140,1200,2520,2700],[0,0.85,0.85,0.0]), and DUCK=0.45. Validate at load: SHIFT_FRAME inside the timeline, fade keyframes monotonic in time, DUCK in (0,1).

Add vitest specs beside src/__tests__/: filmTimeline.test.ts (validateFilmTimeline passes; contiguous; sum 2700; FILM_DURATION in [2250,2700]; every shot window+inPoint <= clip duration using a fixture map so it runs without downloaded files), narration.test.ts (every startFrame in [0,FILM_DURATION); startFrame+durationInFrames<=FILM_DURATION; ids unique; vo13===COPY.s06Tagline, vo15===COPY.s05a, vo16===COPY.s05b; AND beatEnd-(voStart+voDuration) >= 6 for ALL 16 VO lines against their beat ends), footage.test.ts (getFootage throws on unknown key / out-of-range focal / missing duration; every scene footageKey exists), filmMusic.test.ts (SHIFT_FRAME===1140; A fades out and B fades in across the shift; keyframes monotonic; DUCK in (0,1)), filmCopy.test.ts (filmCopy re-exports — not re-literals — the COPY members by reference-equality where applicable; adds exactly visionLine; controlLine === COPY.s04.control.items.join(' · ') asserting SCADA is present; software/infrastructure lines likewise).

Run typecheck and the full ad test suite (neutral config). The existing copy.test.ts MUST remain unchanged and green. Commit the config + tests on feat/cinematic-brand-film (e.g. 'feat(ad): film timeline, copy, footage, narration, grade, music config + tests'). Do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: All six new config modules exist and load without throwing; validateFilmTimeline sums to exactly 2700 and is contiguous from 0.
narration.ts uses MEASURED VO durations and narration.test.ts asserts beatEnd-(voStart+voDuration) >= 6 for all 16 lines (passing).
filmCopy.ts re-exports verbatim COPY members, adds exactly visionLine, and controlLine includes SCADA; filmCopy.test.ts guards this.
The one new on-screen line equals 'Your business has a vision.\nWe build what brings it to life.' and lives only in filmCopy.ts.
footage.ts durations come from FEAT-002 probing and getFootage throws correctly; footage.test.ts passes.
filmMusic SHIFT_FRAME===1140, curves as specified, DUCK in (0,1); filmMusic.test.ts passes.
`node "$NPM" run typecheck` is zero-error; full ad test suite green including the unchanged existing copy snapshot; a commit exists on feat/cinematic-brand-film.

All config modules run validate*() at module load (validateFilmTimeline, validateNarration, validateFilmMusic; getFootage/resolveFootage throw on bad input).

FINAL_LOCKUP_SUB_BEATS_for_FEAT004.note: film09 = 2412-2700 (288f, UNCHANGED). The four sub-beats re-balanced within the 288f budget after the measured VO durations came in longer than the §6 estimates (vo14=120f, vo16=61f). Exported as LOCKUP_BEATS in src/config/filmTimeline.ts. FEAT-004 scenes MUST use THESE exact boundaries.

b2.caption: Your business has a vision.\nWe build what brings it to life. (C9 / vo14)

FINAL_LOCKUP_VO_STARTFRAMES_for_FEAT004.note: Chosen so beatEnd-(voStart+durationInFrames) >= 6 for all four AND startFrame+dur <= 2700, with NO overlapping VO audio (back-to-back from 2412). narration.test.ts asserts the >= 6 invariant for all 16 lines and passes.

findings.non_lockup_vo_startframes_for_FEAT004: vo01=162,vo02=408,vo03=560,vo04=804,vo05=1020,vo06=1152,vo07=1332,vo08=1500,vo09=1632,vo10=1872,vo11=2112,vo12=2292 (durations = measured; all clear their scene end by >= 12f, asserted in narration.test.ts).
findings.DESIGN_DEVIATION_lockup_holds: The rev-4 design/§4 target of a >= 48f full-opacity hold for ALL FOUR sign-off beats is NOT simultaneously achievable with the MEASURED durations: the sum of per-line minimums (durationInFrames + 6f gap, non-overlapping) = 281 + 24 = 305f > film09's 288f. Priorities honored per the briefing: (1) film09 total stays 288f and the nine ranges still sum to 2700; (2) the gated >= 6f VO/beat invariant holds for all 16 lines (narration.test.ts); (3) NO overlapping VO audio; (4) holds maximized -- b1/b2/b4 >= 52f, b2=104f (the longest line gets the most room per the briefing's 'give 9.2 the most room'). b3 (vo15 'Small enough to care.') is the single tight beat at 40f/1.33s hold -- the forced tradeoff. filmTimeline.test.ts asserts b1/b2/b4 >= 48f and all four >= 40f. If FEAT-004/review wants b3 >= 48f, the only levers are shortening another beat's hold or re-recording vo14/vo15 shorter; both change on-screen holds, so this was left as the maximized compromise.
findings.footage_office_open_mapping: footage.ts key 'office-open' maps to file footage/quiet-desk-dawn.mp4 (id 1781 swapped in for 914 per FEAT-002), durationInFrames 360. All 15 cut-clip durations taken from public/footage/SOURCES.md.
findings.grade_window: filmGrade.gradeAt(frame) interpolates cool->warm over GRADE_WARMUP [1140,1500] (§2), cross-fading the steel veil out and the amber veil in; composed only from brand.ts GRADE tokens (brand.ts not edited).
findings.music: filmMusic SHIFT_FRAME=1140; TRACK_A curve [0,60,1020,1080,1140,1200]->[0,0.9,0.9,0.3,0.3,0] (held 0.3 floor 1080-1140); TRACK_B [1140,1200,2520,2700]->[0,0.85,0.85,0]; DUCK=0.45; CROSSFADE [1140,1200]. validateFilmMusic asserts shift inside timeline, monotonic times, volumes in [0,1], DUCK in (0,1).
